test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Hornbill festival is a famous tribal festival. It is celebrated in which of the following North-Eastern states of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is **__Nagaland__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Hornbill Festival is celebrated every year between **December 1 to 10 in Nagaland. **
 
• This festival showcases the rich cultural heritage and tradition of the **Nagas on one platform at Naga Heritage Village Kisama under Kohima District.**
 
• The Hornbill Festival is held at** Kisma located near Kohima**. Kisma is a heritage city specifically constructed to showcase the indigenous tribal culture of Nagaland. 
 
• To encourage inter-tribal interaction and to promote the cultural heritage of Nagaland, the **Government of Nagaland organizes the Hornbill Festival.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** ****Famous Festival Of NorthEast India:__**

 
 
• ​Bihu Event, Assam.
 
• Hornbill Festival, Nagaland.
 
• Wangala Festival, Meghalaya.
 
• Ziro Festival of Music, Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Myoko Festival, Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Lossong in Sikk.im.
 
• Moatsu Mong, Nagaland.
